}}{{TIDTOC|adapter}} ==Overview== {{See also|MediaTek reference design}}
===Features=== *Standards: 802.11abgn/ac/ax compliant :Support 20/40MHz bandwidth in G-band, :and 20/40/80/160MHz bandwidth in A-band *PHY rate: G-Band 2T2R + A-Band 3T3R 2SS, Dual-Band :Dual Concurrent (DBDC) with PHY rate up to 3000Mbps *Support MU-MIMO TX/RX, Support MU-OFDMA TX/RX :Support STBC, LDPC, TX Beamformer and RX Beamformer *Modes: Support greenfield, mixed mode, legacy modes *Security: support for WFA WPA/WPA2/WPA3 personal, WPS2.0 *Intelligent power saving: QoS support of WFA WMM, WMM PS :32-bit RISC MCU for Wi-Fi protocols and Wi-Fi offload *Storage: Embedded SRAM/ROM *Interface: UART with hardware flow control :Programmable and multiplexed GPIO pins *Fully adherent: PCIe device fully compliant to PCIe v2.1 specification :Integrate 4Kbit efuse to store device specific information and calibration data
